24h.frp_sum_definition: sum of reported FRP (MW) across all detections in this cell and window, from every listed platform and overpass -- not instantaneous power or energy
24h.window_span_note: first/last detection time not recorded in this snapshot; the next live refresh carries it. 'dates' lists the UTC acquisition dates.

7d.frp_sum_definition: sum of reported FRP (MW) across all detections in this cell and window, from every listed platform and overpass -- not instantaneous power or energy
7d.window_span_note: first/last detection time not recorded in this snapshot; the next live refresh carries it. 'dates' lists the UTC acquisition dates.

field_definitions.detections: number of active-fire detections (all listed platforms) in the cell during the window
field_definitions.frp_sum_mw: sum of reported FRP (MW) across all detections in this cell and window, from every listed platform and overpass -- not instantaneous power or energy
field_definitions.frp_max_mw: largest single-detection FRP (MW) in the cell during the window
field_definitions.satellites: platforms that contributed at least one detection to the cell, joined with '+'
